title: crypto-ledger v1
description: Movements of crypto assets on own wallets and exchange accounts, each valued in a fiat currency. One file: the accounts, then every movement on them. MIT licensed (schema/LICENSE).

generator.description: What wrote the file, with its version, e.g. `Belege 0.6.0`.

currency.description: The currency every movement's `value` is in.

movements.description: Oldest first. Each movement's `account` names one of `accounts`.

decimal.description: A decimal number as text, `-` for a negative one, `.` as the decimal point, never an exponent: amounts are never floats.

id.description: Unique in the file. A wallet: its CAIP-10 account id (`<caip2>:<address>`). An exchange account: the exchange's id, with a sub-account after a slash (`kraken`, `kraken/earn`).

address.description: As the chain writes it (EVM: lower case). A wallet known by an extended public key (Bitcoin xpub/zpub) is named by a fingerprint of the key instead – never the key itself, which would reveal every address.

exchange.description: The exchange, by its ccxt id where it has one (`kraken`, `binance`).

decimals.description: Decimals of the smallest unit the source counts in (ETH 18, BTC 8; an exchange may keep more or fewer).

caip19.description: The asset as CAIP-19, where it is unambiguous: `eip155:1/slip44:60` (ETH), `eip155:8453/erc20:0x8335…` (a token by its contract). A symbol alone says nothing about which token it is; a token is only ever identified by its contract.

value.description: What the movement was worth on its day, in the file's `currency`.

amount.description: Signed like the movement, rounded to the currency's smallest unit (cents).

rate.description: Per whole unit of the asset.

source.description: Where the rate comes from: `coingecko`, `kraken`, `ecb`, `trade` (the price of the trade itself), `dex` (a pool's price at the block), `migration`, `manual`; `currency` for the file's own currency (rate 1) – or another source's own name.

at.description: The moment the rate is for.

ref.description: What identifies the price further, e.g. a DEX pool and block: `uniswap-v2:<pool>@<block>`.

id.description: Stable: the same movement read again gets the same id, so an importer can skip what it knows. Unique per account. A fee is a movement of its own, by convention `<hash>:fee`.

date.description: The day it is booked on (UTC for chains).

kind.description: transfer: in or out, to or from anyone, an own wallet too. trade: one leg of an exchange's trade (the legs share `ref`). swap: one leg of a swap on a chain (the legs share `txHash`). fee: a network or exchange fee. reward: staking or earn income. stake: delegated or returned from staking. mining: a mined block.

amount.description: Signed: positive in, negative out; at most `asset.decimals` decimals.

value.description: null while no rate is known.

txHash.description: The transaction on the chain, as the chain writes it. On an exchange: the hash of a deposit or withdrawal, where the exchange names it – this pairs it with the wallet's side.

ref.description: An exchange's own reference (Kraken: `refid`), shared by the legs of a trade and by an entry and its fee.

network.description: An exchange's deposit or withdrawal: the network it names for `txHash`, in its words.

sourceType.description: How the source names the entry, as it does: `deposit`, `transfer/spottostaking`.
